title: Scientists Made Something 26 Billion Times Colder Than Space

scenes.text: Scientists made something twenty-six billion times colder than space.
The coldest place in nature is about one degree above absolute zero.
In 2021, German scientists chilled a cloud of atoms to thirty-eight trillionths of a degree above it.
They dropped the experiment down a 120 metre tower.
In free fall, the cloud kept cooling.
It held that temperature for about two seconds.
Colder than space, for two seconds, in a lab in Germany.

description:
In 2021 researchers in Bremen, Germany, cooled a cloud of atoms to 38 trillionths of a degree above absolute zero.
That is about 26 billion times colder than the coldest known place in nature.
What would you test at that temperature?
first_comment: What do you think happens to matter that close to absolute zero?
